title: document-engineering components are imported from the /scalars subpath, where the boolean input is BooleanField and no Checkbox export exists
content:
`@powerhousedao/document-engineering` provides pre-built components, many keyed to GraphQL scalar types so they line up with document-model schemas. The form tier is imported from the `/scalars` subpath:

```tsx
import { Form, StringField, BooleanField } from "@powerhousedao/document-engineering/scalars";
```

**There is no `Checkbox` export.** The boolean input is `BooleanField`, exported from `src/scalars/components/boolean-field/index.ts`. The string `Checkbox` does appear inside the repo (22 files) but only as internal implementation and story naming — it is not exported from any index, so importing it will fail.

The scalar-backed field components under `src/scalars/components/` are: `aid-field`, `amount-field`, `boolean-field`, `country-code-field`, `currency-code-field`, `date-picker-field`, `date-time-picker-field`, `email-field`, `enum-field`, `file-field`, `id-field`, `number-field`, `oid-field`, `password-field`, `phid-field`, `phone-number-field`, `string-field`, `time-picker-field`, `url-field`, plus `form` and shared `fragments`.

Components are explored in Storybook. The repo itself only documents running it locally (`pnpm storybook`, per `README.md:95`); the hosted `storybook.powerhouse.academy` URL is asserted by the academy docs and cannot be confirmed from this repo.

Note this package is versioned independently of the Powerhouse stack — pinned as a dependency (`1.40.5`), not built from the powerhouse monorepo, so its symbols will never appear in a monorepo grep.

_Source-verified 2026-08-13 against the document-engineering repo at v1.40.5 (`/home/p/Powerhouse/document-engineering`), a separate repo from the powerhouse monorepo._
